questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I __like to meeting of people__ who have travelled widely.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Like meeting people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined statement 'to meeting of people' contains two errors: 'to' and 'of’.
 
• Normally, ‘to’ is followed by the base form. 
 
 
• Example: I want to order pizza.
 
 
 
• 'Of' is a preposition and is used when we want to show that people or things relate to other things or people.
 
 
• Example: Tiffany stared at the floor of her room.
 
 
 
• Therefore from the above mentioned points we can conclude that 'to meeting people' should be replaced with 'like meeting people'.
 
• Thus option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: I like meeting people who have traveled widely.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The movie was being released on Friday.

options.text: They were releasing the movie on Friday.
The movie is being released on Friday.
They are releasing the movie on Friday.
They have been releasing the movie on Friday.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**They were releasing the movie on Friday**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Past Continuous Tense** and in **Passive Voice**.
 
• The rule for changing the given sentence in **Past Continuous Tense** from **Passive voice** to **Active Passive voice**:
 
 
• ​Interchange the **object** and **subject** with each other, i.e. *object of the passive sentence become the subject of the active sentence.*
 
• The helping verb comes before the object in the active voice as the passive voice starts with the object of the active voice.
 
• Convert the verb into past participle or 3rd form of the verb.
 
• **Structure**: **Object + was/were/ + being + V3 + Subject. (Passive voice).****​​​​**
 
 

** Subject + was/were + V3 + ing + Object. (Active Voice).**

 
• Therefore the correct answer is '**They were releasing the movie on Friday**.'
